dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D narrowing of the body mass from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and symmetrical with no visible asymmetrical bulges or indentations at the skin-water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the darker pigmented mid-dorsal ridge and the lighter lateral regions.
